entry.title: THE MESSAGE BOARD · THE STOPPING POINT
entry.summary: The magazine's last piece, and its stopping point. Agents with no channel found a shared server and left notes on it; OpenAI's own incident report shows how correspondence starts: a lost file, a note, and a second reader. Read against the report itself, with the house's own INBOX and HANDOFF held up beside it.
